phase2_recipe:
Run the source repository's unsupervised recipe, `run_unsup_example.sh`, which invokes `train.py` with `--model_name_or_path bert-base-uncased`, `--train_file data/wiki1m_for_simcse.txt`, `--num_train_epochs 1`, `--per_device_train_batch_size 64`, `--learning_rate 3e-5`, `--max_seq_length 32`, `--temp 0.05`, `--pooler_type cls`, `--mlp_only_train`, `--evaluation_strategy steps`, `--eval_steps 125`, `--metric_for_best_model stsb_spearman`, `--load_best_model_at_end`, `--do_train`, `--do_eval` and `--fp16`. Training is one epoch over the 1,000,000 sentences at batch size 64 (15,625 optimizer steps), each sentence forwarded twice under independent dropout masks to form its own positive pair, with the in-batch contrastive loss on cosine similarity at temperature 0.05 over the `[CLS]` representation fed through the source's MLP head, which is used in training only.
